maddeler.e:
وببت (form I)
# وَبَبْتُ (wababtu) /wa.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of وَبَّ (wabba)
# وَبَبْتَ (wababta) /wa.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of وَبَّ (wabba)
# وَبَبْتِ (wababti) /wa.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of وَبَّ (wabba)
# وُبِبْتُ (wubibtu) /wu.bib.tu/: first-person singular past passive of وَبَّ (wabba)
# وُبِبْتَ (wubibta) /wu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
